comment: Spec 0012 licence test vectors, generated by go run ./internal/license/vectorgen.
Signed with test-only keys that no release build trusts; keys lists the trusted one.
Check each token for ext and version (empty: the range is skipped) at now (seconds since the epoch).
An invalid token names the rule it breaks (license.Rule* in internal/license); its claims are null.
Claims use kista's names: key is the header's kid, issuer iss, id jti, holder_id sub, extension ext;
grace is in seconds with the default (604800) filled in; holder, versions and limits are left out when absent;
limits are a list of {name, value} in the payload's order.
